question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

w_xxyywwx_yywwxxyyww_xyywwxx_y
solution:
The logic followed here is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10daaf369b7dd308421e247cc8d04e859ff179455cf57e33aa4fe4f7aefba1b1.png] 

Here, we can see that the series follows a repeating sequence of 'wwxxyy'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****wxxy"**.
